facts.fact: Resolution 69/2021 states the Government approved its first Informatics Policy by Resolution 28/2000 and, 18 years later, revised it and approved it as the Information Society Policy by Resolution 17/2018 of 21 June; it describes the cybersecurity strategy as part of implementing that policy.
